title.narrative: Support for the Development of the National Strategy for Culture 2030 in Moldova

description.narrative: The Republic of Moldova is gifted with a rich and diverse cultural heritage, reflecting significant parts of the European history and identity. The country is also a vibrant hub of contemporary creativity, with lively cultural spaces, dynamic creative industries as well as important cultural infrastructure such as festivals and events. With this in mind, the proposed project is focused on re-visioning and revival of the culture sector as an imperative for the social and economic development of the country. This implies creation of favourable conditions for the sector growth by the development of a policy document on culture, ensuring quality data and information for better policy making and budgeting, increasing human and technical capacities in the field of cultural management and protection of cultural heritage especially focused on fighting illicit trafficking of cultural property also by reinforcing the role of museums, as well as strengthened cultural cooperation and increased mobility of artists and culture professionals. The overall objective of the proposed project is to enhance the socio-economic impact of the culture and creative sector in the Republic of Moldova, by increasing the sector’s capacities for safeguarding cultural heritage and promoting the diversity of cultural expressions. This will be achieved by ensuring equitable access to cultural services for all citizens, preserving and valorising cultural heritage, stimulating cultural and creative industries, encouraging cultural education, as well as participatory and inclusive policymaking in the field of culture. The activities will lead to increased engagement of various stakeholders in the policymaking process and greater participation in cultural life . This implies expanding access to cultural opportunities and activities, safeguarding cultural heritage, traditions and the diversity of cultural expressions, and providing opportunities for personal development and active citizenship.
